conventional.indices_0_to_31: Eight oldest-to-newest completed video-request rows: [Mbps/10 clipped0..3, HTTP duration_s/2 clipped0..10, seconds since completion/30 clipped0..1, present]. Left pad [0,0,1,0].
conventional.indices_32_to_35: [buffer_s/target_s clipped0..4, previous nominal bitrate/max nominal bitrate, (playback_rate-1)/0.17 clipped-1..1, target_s/6 clipped0..2]

leo_extension.indices_36_to_59: Eight oldest-to-newest completed polled health rows: [successful RTT_ms/200 clipped0..5 or0 on failure, seconds since probe completion/4 clipped0..1, successful measurement flag]. Left pad [0,1,0].
leo_extension.indices_60_to_63: [live_latency_s/3 clipped0..8, last-success age_s/3 clipped0..1 (missing=1), latest probe valid and success younger than3s, fraction of failed rows in available history (empty=1)]

history_cadence: Production RTT health polled every0.5s; last8 distinct probe timestamps retained, not a guaranteed uniform4s window. Simulator approximates response/poll cadence.
network: 36/64 ->64 ReLU ->64 ReLU ->8 logits; first-index deterministic argmax
reward: Q-4B-S-0.3V-0.1A, with same units as played-ledger-v2; approximate simulator dynamics quantified separately
normalization: Fixed physical constants; no fitted test-data transform
comparison_scope: LEO group adds explicit RTT history/freshness and live latency together. Conventional playback rate can indirectly reflect latency; this is not an isolated causal test of RTT alone.
runtime: Synchronous JS actor in Chrome main thread; asynchronously refreshed measurements are cached before inference. No Promise returned to dash.js.
fallback: Lowest representation on missing model, mismatched ladder, invalid input/output; no hard preemption of a synchronous call
reference_qualification: Retrained player-compatible A2C inspired by Pensieve/Gelato/Plume, not unchanged released ten-action Maguro weights
